topic: Database user permissions for production deployment
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on setting up database access credentials for a system moving to production. It was noted that the current setup uses default configurations, which is insufficient for proper functionality.

[p1] confirmed that a new user needs to be created with write permissions but must have highly restricted rights. A key requirement emphasized was preventing the new user from having Data Definition Language (DDL) privileges to avoid accidental data deletion or structural changes.
decisions: A new, limited-write database user account will be created for the system's production deployment.
action_items: [me] to create the restricted write-access user account.
